title: Release notes executor
description: Combines the changelog sections of a fixed release group into one set of GitHub release notes.

group.description: Name of the release group in nx.json.

tag.description: The release tag, for example v1.2.3. The version is extracted using the group's release tag pattern.

output.description: File to write the notes to, relative to the workspace root. When omitted, the notes are printed to stdout together with the Nx task output.
